test_dis6_function: test the dis6.dis6 function to disassemble a regular Python function into StrongJIT IR
test_dis6_lambda: test the dis6.dis6 function to disassemble a lambda expression into StrongJIT IR
test_dis6_bound_method: test the dis6.dis6 function to disassemble a bound method into StrongJIT IR
test_dis6_unbound_method: test the dis6.dis6 function to disassemble an unbound method into StrongJIT IR
test_dis6_callable: test the dis6.dis6 function to disassemble a callable __call__ method into StrongJIT IR
